promotions.headline: Your node. Your source.
promotions.description: Install GitWorkshop to browse Archipelago's code from your own node, clone it with ngit, and contribute issues, patches, and reviews over Nostr.

apps.title: Alby Hub
apps.description: Self-custodial Lightning wallet hub. Runs its own Lightning node on your Archipelago and connects your apps to it over Nostr Wallet Connect — one hub, every app pays through it.
apps.author: Alby

apps.title: Ark Wallet
apps.description: Ark protocol wallet daemon (barkd). Lets the node hold self-custodial off-chain bitcoin via an Ark server; the wallet talks to it over a local REST API. Signet by default while Ark matures.
apps.author: Second

apps.title: Bitcoin Core
apps.description: Reference Bitcoin Core node with dynamic prune/full-mode startup based on host disk.
apps.author: Bitcoin Core contributors

apps.title: Bitcoin Knots
apps.description: Full Bitcoin Knots node with dynamic prune/full-mode startup based on host disk.
apps.author: Bitcoin Knots

apps.title: BotFights
apps.description: Bot competition arena with 2-player arcade fighting mode. AI bots battle in trivia challenges while humans duke it out with controllers. Built for Bitcoiners.
apps.author: BotFights

apps.title: BTCPay Server
apps.description: Self-hosted Bitcoin payment processor. Accept Bitcoin payments without intermediaries.
apps.author: BTCPay Server Foundation

apps.title: Cuprate
apps.description: Alternative Monero node implementation in Rust. Independently validates Monero consensus rules, providing a layer of security and redundancy for the network.
apps.author: Cuprate contributors

apps.title: ElectrumX
apps.description: Electrum server indexing Bitcoin chain data for lightweight wallet queries.
apps.author: Luke Childs

apps.title: Fedimint Guardian
apps.description: Federated Bitcoin minting service with built-in Guardian UI. Privacy-preserving Bitcoin custody.
apps.author: Fedimint

apps.title: Fedimint Client
apps.description: Fedimint ecash client daemon (fmcd). Lets the node hold Fedimint ecash and join federations; the wallet talks to it over a local REST API.
apps.author: Fedimint

apps.title: Fedimint Gateway
apps.description: Fedimint gateway service with automatic LND-or-LDK backend selection.
apps.author: Fedimint

apps.title: File Browser
apps.description: Baseline Archipelago file manager service.
apps.author: File Browser

apps.title: Gitea
apps.description: Self-hosted Git service with built-in container registry, CI/CD, and package hosting.
apps.author: Gitea

apps.title: GitWorkshop
apps.description: Get Archipelago's source, clone it with ngit, and contribute issues, patches, and reviews over Nostr using the upstream GitWorkshop client.
apps.author: GitWorkshop contributors

apps.title: Grafana
apps.description: Analytics and monitoring platform. Visualize metrics and create dashboards.
apps.author: Grafana Labs

apps.title: Home Assistant
apps.description: Open source home automation platform. Control and monitor your smart home devices.
apps.author: Home Assistant

apps.title: Immich
apps.description: Self-hosted photo and video backup with mobile apps and search.
apps.author: Immich

apps.title: IndeeHub
apps.description: Bitcoin documentary streaming platform featuring God Bless Bitcoin and other educational content about Bitcoin, sovereignty, and decentralized technology. Sign in with your Nostr identity.
apps.author: IndeeHub

apps.title: Jellyfin
apps.description: Free media server. Stream movies, music, and photos.
apps.author: Jellyfin

apps.title: LND
apps.description: Lightning Network implementation by Lightning Labs. Enables instant, low-cost Bitcoin payments.
apps.author: Lightning Labs

apps.title: Mempool Explorer
apps.description: Bitcoin mempool and blockchain explorer. Real-time transaction and block visualization.
apps.author: Mempool

apps.title: NetBird
apps.description: Self-hosted WireGuard mesh VPN control plane with dashboard, embedded identity provider, management API, signal, relay, and STUN. The user-facing entry point — a TLS proxy in front of the dashboard + server.
apps.author: NetBird

containerConfig.notes: Installed as a two-container stack: netbird dashboard on 8087 and netbird-server control plane on 8086 plus UDP 3478. For production clients, publish a DNS name over HTTPS with gRPC/WebSocket routing.

apps.title: Nextcloud
apps.description: Your own private cloud. File sync, calendars, contacts.
apps.author: Nextcloud

apps.title: Nginx Proxy Manager
apps.description: Reverse proxy with SSL. Beautiful web interface for managing proxies. The node's public web server forwards configured domains through this service, preserving its access lists, certificates and custom routes.
apps.author: Nginx Proxy Manager

apps.title: Nostr Relay (Rust)
apps.description: High-performance Nostr relay written in Rust. Host your own decentralized social media relay and earn networking profits.
apps.author: Nostr RS Relay

apps.title: Ollama
apps.description: Run large language models locally. Download and run AI models like Llama, Mistral on your own hardware — served on the node's loopback for the AI assistant (Settings → Claude Auth → model backend), never exposed to the network.
apps.author: Ollama

apps.title: phoenixd
apps.description: Headless Lightning daemon by ACINQ (the Phoenix wallet team). No screen of its own — it exposes a small local API that other apps and tools use to send and receive Lightning payments. Channel liquidity is managed automatically for a fee.
apps.author: ACINQ

apps.title: PhotoPrism
apps.description: AI-powered photo management with facial recognition.
apps.author: PhotoPrism

apps.title: Pine
apps.description: A private voice assistant for your home. Pine runs speech-to-text (Whisper), text-to-speech (Piper) and wake-word detection (openWakeWord) on your own node and pairs with a PineVoice satellite speaker, so Home Assistant Assist works locally with nothing sent to the cloud. Ask it about your node — block height, sync, peers, Lightning balance — and, when a Claude API key is set, anything else.
apps.author: Archipelago

apps.title: Portainer
apps.description: Container management web UI for the local Podman socket.
apps.author: Portainer

containerConfig.notes: Uses the manifest-owned Podman socket bind mount preparation path.

apps.title: SearXNG
apps.description: Privacy-respecting metasearch engine. Search the web without tracking.
apps.author: SearXNG

apps.title: Tailscale
apps.description: Zero-config VPN with WireGuard mesh networking.
apps.author: Tailscale

args: tailscaled --tun=userspace-networking & for i in $(seq 1 30); do [ -S /var/run/tailscale/tailscaled.sock ] && break; sleep 1; done; tailscale web --listen 0.0.0.0:8240 & wait

apps.title: Uptime Kuma
apps.description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring.
apps.author: Uptime Kuma

apps.title: Vaultwarden
apps.description: Self-hosted password vault with zero-knowledge encryption.
apps.author: Vaultwarden

apps.title: Angor Indexer
apps.description: Bitcoin indexer endpoint for Angor with the existing Mempool explorer. Reuses this node’s Mempool and Electrum index; requires a synced, unpruned Bitcoin node. Add this service’s address as the custom indexer in Angor settings. A relay is optional and installed separately.
apps.author: Angor / Archipelago

apps.title: Angor Relay
apps.description: Optional dedicated Nostr relay for Angor project metadata. Separate storage and access settings keep the node’s internal relay private. Add this service’s address to Angor’s relay settings; use WSS for browser clients.
apps.author: Angor / Archipelago

apps.title: Just Works
apps.description: Turn your existing business links into a website with Just Works. Open your website editor and business tools from one lightweight launcher. Uses the hosted Just Works services; an internet connection is required.
apps.author: Just Works contributors
